rec.name: Testimonial Videos Section (Carousel with Social Proof Badge)
rec.status: Built — revised and fixed (Mar 2025), client informed

what.text: A reusable section (theme name 'CRO | Global | Testimonial Videos') that shows customer testimonial videos under a centered headline and a short intro line. The videos are shown as a swipeable carousel with playable video cards. A round dark badge with a headline stat (e.g. '300,000+ customers love [brand]') overlaps the top-right of the video area. The 'Learn more' button was removed after client feedback.

why.text: Real customers speaking on video are harder to fake than written reviews, so they build credibility and lower purchase anxiety. The large-number badge adds aggregate social proof (many people already trust the brand) right next to the individual stories. Removing the 'Learn more' button keeps attention on the videos instead of sending visitors away.

how.text: Build it as a section with a heading, a subheading, a badge and repeatable video blocks. Use a carousel/slider layout so videos can be swiped on mobile. The carousel must keep working when merchants edit blocks or settings in the theme editor; this was the bug in the first version. On mobile the headline is centered and non-italic, like the other sections in the theme. There is no CTA button.

items: Headline text (centered and non-italic on mobile, matching other sections)
Video blocks (repeatable; each with a video file/URL and a poster image)
Carousel on/off and swipe behavior (must survive editing)
Optional 'Learn more' button (removed in this client's version)

dependencies.text: Theme section with video blocks (uploaded video or video URL). No metafields or apps are mentioned. A slider script is assumed for the carousel but is not named. Headline styling must follow the global theme typography.

items: Conversion rate and add-to-cart rate on pages with the section vs. without

images.caption: Mobile view of the Testimonial Videos section before the revision: headline and intro text, a round dark '300,000+ customers love' badge at top right, and video cards with a play overlay and native controls. The headline here is still italic and left-aligned, which the client asked to change to centered and non-italic.
